hypothesis: A bounded provision-level temporal resolver can identify the verified rule applicable now or on an exact date without treating the newest PDF as a whole-document replacement, and can abstain whenever candidate identity or legal lineage is incomplete.

configuration.current_date_policy: evaluate local process date for each request

changed: page-bounded mapping from ordinary retrieval seeds to verified affected provisions
French, Arabic, and English temporal-rule routing for current, historical, and future exact-date questions
verified as-of provision-version selection and source-linked lineage assembly
mandatory temporal context in the answer path
deterministic abstention for absent, unavailable, ambiguous, incomplete, or unordered lineage

persistent_read_verification.query: What rule in Article 4 is currently in force?

conclusion: Keep the fail-closed temporal resolver. It can resolve a provision only when one page-bounded target, one verified as-of version, and a complete evidenced lineage agree; otherwise the answer path abstains instead of selecting the newest document.
limitations: The persistent graph currently has only three verified DECLARES_CHANGE facts, and their predecessor chains are incomplete; the real Article 4 case therefore correctly abstains.
The 6255 semantic candidates remain unverified and are not used as legal-effect relationships.
Only page-bounded outgoing change-source seeds are mapped to provisions; target-instrument pages without safe page-to-provision evidence abstain.
Historical questions require an exact YYYY-MM-DD or DD/MM/YYYY date; year-only and undated evolution questions abstain.
Candidate disambiguation supports one candidate or one exact provision-label match.
The public API response model does not expose the internal graph trace.
No answer-quality benchmark or accuracy claim was made; provisional and final evaluation sets remained unopened.
recommendation: For each newly ingested PDF, verify and persist exact affected provisions, effective dates, predecessor and successor provision versions, and source-page quotes. Add safe target-page-to-provision evidence mapping, then run a frozen gold-blind answer and citation evaluation before production promotion.
